sections.heading: Chapter I: Autobots Turn
sections.text:
On September 26, 2019, the first chapter of the Act, Autobots Turn, launched.

Continuing from where Generations left off, Wheeljack and Jetfire are launched into a potential crisis as they end up in a parallel timeline (perhaps this was where alternate-Arcee originated from) where Megatronus' Titan-related carnage has not started. Emphasis on the has not.

There are no Autobots, no Marissa, no way to get back; all they face are corrupted Bots from a plethora of realities, ready to scrap the two. And with Shockwave in the mix, they are in for some serious trouble! To get back, they will have to put their Sparks on the line, as their journey home begins...

May you find continued joy and delight in this treasured franchise my friends.
'Till all are one.|- Vin_Cent : silly storyteller human, last Discord message}}

'''Special Missions''' are limited-time Solo-player missions to promote new characters and side stories. They are unlocked at player level 12.

The main type of Special Mission are '''Spotlight Missions''', which are story-driven missions with multiple difficulty levels. 

There are also occasional gauntlets such as '''Challenge Missions''', which present you with short maps with six bots that have special [[Utility Module]] buffs in three difficulties. Or ''Fog of War'', the most viable way to get all tiers of Class Spark essence especially tier 4, but doesn't appear that often.

=== Chrono-Vector: [[Grimlock Saves the Day|Grimlock Saves the Day!]] ===
''Wheeljack has been experimenting on a device that could harness the many new and strange energies on New Quintessa. His new, and untested, Chrono-Vector Device could POTENTIALLY allow the user to travel along a time-bridge. Unfortunately the first unexpected test-run is manned by Grimlock, a dinobot on a mission. Can Wheeljack and Optimus Prime stop the mighty Grimlock from unravelling the past? Only TIME will tell!''

* '''Date:''' June 6th-20th
* '''Notes:'''

=== Reforged - [[Code of a Hero]] ===

=== [[Till All Are Gone]] ===
''The Reforging Energy triggered by Megatronus trying to awaken the mysterious Titan has thrown the world into disarray. Fearing what may be happening, the Autobots send a scout towards the epicentre of a disturbance, in hopes that they may identify the Titan, or at least find some answers. However, the communications they received were troubling, before stopping all together... Things go from bad to worse when a new foe wearing a familiar face joins the fray. The sinister [[Nemesis Prime]]. Created using a subspace impulse cloner, Nemesis Prime is a malicious copy of the heroic Optimus Prime. Although he wears the Decepticon insignia, it’s unclear where his loyalties lie. Now Commander, it’s up to you and Optimus to try and hold things together and fight off the emerging darkness in the suspenseful new Spotlight Mission, Till All Are Gone!''

* Date: July 4th~

=== [[Scorponok and Waspinator Story Arc|A Tale Of Two Stingers]] ===
''Two Stingers, No Clue! - Adding to the troubles of an already war-torn world, the Predacon forces are on the move. Luckily, those forces number just two: Scorponok and Waspinator. The destructive duo are looking for a Space Bridge to bring down more of their kind, but seem to be bumping into Bots in the middle of far more epic and odd missions than they are on. Will their spiteful stingers wound this world, or will they merely be a buzzing annoyance?''

* '''Date:''' August 1~2

=== Fog of War: [[Null-Field]] ===
''The Decepticons have developed cloaking technology and are using it to ambush us out in the field. They must be stopped.''

* '''Date:''' August 15 until August 22nd
* '''Notes:''' ''In this first Fog Of War Map, Commanders will be challenged by unknown assailants on what looks like an empty map.''
** ''These cloaked Bots guard the way to your final struggle with the one and only, Megatronus!''

*Completion Rewards: 10,000 5-Star Bot Crystal Shards, 1 Tier 4 Basic Spark, 1 of each Tier 3 Class Spark, 10 5-Star Signature Upgrades, [[Stable Nucleon Core]] Relic

===[[Rise of Kolkular]]===
Thundercracker attempts to bring the Decepticon base to New Quintessa. If you are to stop him, he has imposed a two-bot limit and six Class Gates potentially blocking your path. At least he has a <strike>heart</strike> spark light enough to node his challenges with potentially very overpowered modules. If you are able to strike him down, you will get a handsome reward...

Also, Titan Fragments!

Special Missions are limited-time Solo-player missions to promote new characters and side stories. They are unlocked at player level 12.

The main type of Special Mission are Spotlight Missions, which are story-driven missions with multiple difficulty levels. 

There are also occasional gauntlets such as Challenge Missions, which present you with short maps with six bots that have special Utility Module buffs in three difficulties. Or Fog of War, the most viable way to get all tiers of Class Spark essence especially tier 4, but doesn't appear that often.

sections.heading: Chrono-Vector: Grimlock Saves the Day!
sections.text:
Wheeljack has been experimenting on a device that could harness the many new and strange energies on New Quintessa. His new, and untested, Chrono-Vector Device could POTENTIALLY allow the user to travel along a time-bridge. Unfortunately the first unexpected test-run is manned by Grimlock, a dinobot on a mission. Can Wheeljack and Optimus Prime stop the mighty Grimlock from unravelling the past? Only TIME will tell!

* Date: June 6th-20th
* Notes:

sections.heading: Till All Are Gone
sections.text:
The Reforging Energy triggered by Megatronus trying to awaken the mysterious Titan has thrown the world into disarray. Fearing what may be happening, the Autobots send a scout towards the epicentre of a disturbance, in hopes that they may identify the Titan, or at least find some answers. However, the communications they received were troubling, before stopping all together... Things go from bad to worse when a new foe wearing a familiar face joins the fray. The sinister Nemesis Prime. Created using a subspace impulse cloner, Nemesis Prime is a malicious copy of the heroic Optimus Prime. Although he wears the Decepticon insignia, it’s unclear where his loyalties lie. Now Commander, it’s up to you and Optimus to try and hold things together and fight off the emerging darkness in the suspenseful new Spotlight Mission, Till All Are Gone!

* Date: July 4th~

sections.heading: A Tale Of Two Stingers
sections.text:
Two Stingers, No Clue! - Adding to the troubles of an already war-torn world, the Predacon forces are on the move. Luckily, those forces number just two: Scorponok and Waspinator. The destructive duo are looking for a Space Bridge to bring down more of their kind, but seem to be bumping into Bots in the middle of far more epic and odd missions than they are on. Will their spiteful stingers wound this world, or will they merely be a buzzing annoyance?

* Date: August 1~2

sections.heading: Fog of War: Null-Field
sections.text:
The Decepticons have developed cloaking technology and are using it to ambush us out in the field. They must be stopped.

* Date: August 15 until August 22nd
* Notes: In this first Fog Of War Map, Commanders will be challenged by unknown assailants on what looks like an empty map.
** These cloaked Bots guard the way to your final struggle with the one and only, Megatronus!
** Of course no challenge is without rewards and this will be a way for Commanders to obtain hard to find Class Essence! Getting past these ambushes come with a high energy cost, but will reward you with Class Spark Essence for the Bot that you defeat.
** There are 4 difficulties to choose from. The higher the Difficulty, the rarer the Tier of Class Spark Essence!
** Deception - 10 T1 Class Spark Essence per Fight
** Deceit - 60 Class T2 Spark Essence per Fight
** Disguise - 135 T3 Class Spark Essence per Fight
** Darken - 40 T4 Class Spark Essence per Fight
** You may encounter an occasional tougher Enemy! While they’re more dangerous, defeating them will reward 4x the Class Essence!

sections.heading: Prime Suspect
sections.text: * Date: August 28

sections.heading: Chrono-Vector: Generations
sections.text: * Date: Sept 12th - Sept 25th

sections.heading: Magnus Opus
sections.text:
The devious doubles and clever clones SEEM to have left New Quintessa but they have created havoc in their wake. The Autobots can no longer trust one another, and one Bot's return has started to create a clash between factions. Ultra Magnus is at the center of a conflict he can't hope to overcome in one piece. It will be up to Ratchet and Grimlock to visit their friends and see if sense can be made from a world where nothing is as it seems. Will the Autobots find harmony? Or will this tune split up their merry band? FIND OUT in the first entry of this new TRILOGY of spotlights CIVIL WAR: CHAPTER 1 - MAGNUS OPUS.

Date: January 2nd

sections.heading: Speak No Evil
sections.text:
Around this point onward Spotlight Missions were sub-titled Time-Slides, shorter 2-week missions.

The Time-Slides continue to throw all of New Quintessa across infinite possibilities and realities. Skilled Cityspeaker Windblade discovers that many of the planets had different Titans slumbering within them. Will these massive monsters hold clues that can help her friends? Or is she lost to wander the timelines? Find out more in SPEAK NO EVIL.

* Date: July 30-August 13, 2020
*Notes: Revamps difficulties to the current 4 -level Novice-Captain-Commander-Prime difficulties.

sections.heading: Starscream's Brigade
sections.text:
We join with the Starscream of another Timeline who has gotten what he wanted, he now "leads" the Decepticons. But there is no happily ever after for this treacherous Bot. The Commander is forced to join in to keep up appearances on this twisted world, but how long will the duo last as STARSCREAM'S BRIGADE?

*Date: August 13-27, 2020

sections.heading: Doctor's Orders
sections.text:
Ratchet finds the Commander and recruits them to help with the repair of some Bots. However not everyone is excited to see both sides of the war getting patched by the Autobot Doc. Will Ratchet be able to have the patience to save his patients? We'll have to follow DOCTOR'S ORDERS! An all new adventure inspired by the Netflix series TRANSFORMERS: WAR FOR CYBERTRON

*Date: October 1-15, 2020
*Featured Bots:

sections.heading: Evil Tread - From Rust Till Dawn
Evil Tread - Monster Hunt
sections.text:
Ultra Magnus looks to exorcise spectral corruptions from Autobots and Decepticons alike! Can Ultra Magnus record his findings and survive this harrowing experience? Find out in Evil Tread - Monster Hunt! 

*Date: October 15th~29th, 2020
*Featured Bots: - Bonecrusher, Optimus Primal, Ultra Magnus
*Notes: First to be announced on fully migrated Discord

sections.heading: Shock To The Spark
sections.text:
The minds of Autobots and Decepticons have mysteriously been wiped! Restore their minds and find the culprit in Shock to the Spark.

*Date: October 29th~November 12th, 2020
*Featured Bots: Hot Rod, Galvatron, Optimus Prime (MV1)

sections.heading: Logical Fallacy
sections.text:
This timeline jump once again brings the Commander into the middle of the Cybertronian Civil War. Jetfire encounters an Autobot seeking to gather medical supplies to assist all those who need help. Will this be the spark that lets a seeker see the error of his ways? Or will they draw the wrong conclusions? Find out in LOGICAL FALLACY. 

*Date: November 12th ~ 26th
* Featured Bots: Hot Rod, Galvatron, Optimus Prime (MV1)

sections.heading: Primal Rage
sections.text:
Time-Slides continue to throw our teams across infinite realities and possibilities. In this Time-Slide, Optimus Primal seems to be infected by a Predacon virus causing him to go into a blind rage.
*Date: November 26th~December 10th

sections.heading: Silent Night, Ember Light
sections.text:
In this Holiday Time-Slide, Shattered Glass has returned to wish good tidings and happy holidays to Optimus on Ember Festival Day! However, it turns our the mirror universe doppelganger is not alone...

*Date: December 10th~31st
*Bots of the Month:

sections.heading: Mad Mixmaster
sections.text:
A time-slide into a world where the only way to be ruler is to be ruthless. If you're not smashing you're about to be smashed. Will Marissa be able to steer the Commander through constant attacks, or will they get ground up and remade by MAD MIXMASTER?

* Date: December 31st ~ January 14th
*Featured Bots: Jazz, Starscream, Ratchet

sections.heading: Missing Aspects
sections.text:
A Time-Slide to a world where Megatronus was not seeking the power of a Titan but Aspects of a strange ancient artifact called the Emberstone. A tool made to create life, but capable of providing untold power to those who look to corrupt it. The Commander will have to make some dark alliances to find out more as they look for MISSING ASPECTS. 

*Date: January 14th ~ January 28th
*Featured Bots:

sections.heading: Heavy Metal
sections.text:
Jetfire and Wheeljack are trying to fix a powerful Space Bridge to organize the Autobots back together. Unfortunately, Heavy Munition Bots are programmed to guard or destroy the bridge before it can be switched on. 

*Date: January 28th ~ February 10th
*Bots of the Month: Soundwave, Bludgeon, Ramjet

sections.heading: Time After Time
sections.text:
Encoded notes are streaming from the future and they are all addressed to Starscream. Marissa is forced to track along with the Decepticon as he looks for the source of this secretive author. Will the mystery be solved or will the letters spell out certain doom? Find out in TIME AFTER TIME! 

* Date: February 11th ~ February 25th
*Notes: First Spotlight mission of the 8.5 update

sections.heading: Headmaster and Commander
sections.text:
Wheeljack and Jetfire have begun to piece together some of the scattered Time-Slides, but that doesn’t mean everything is going well. As Scorponok peers into a timeline where he’s a gigantic protector of a Space Bridge! He sees this as a true calling and will protect the timelines no matter the cost. Will the Autobots be able to fight off this multi-minded menace? Or will they finally fall? Find out by playing HEADMASTER AND COMMANDER! 

*Date: February 25th ~ March 11th
*Bots of the Month: Ironhide, Windblade, Blaster, Motormaster
*Notes: introduces Rank 6 5-Star Bots

sections.heading: Prime Conflicts
sections.text:
Optimus Prime finds himself stolen out of time and space, floating in a Dead Universe. He must face off against his darkest reflections and be judged by the universe itself if he ever hopes to return. Will Optimus keep his Spark lit, or is it about to be snuffed in PRIME CONFLICTS!?

* Date: March 11th ~ March 31st
*Bots of the Month:

sections.heading: Shock, Scream, Thunder
sections.text:
The Space Bridge has brought the Commander back to New Quintessa but without the team of Autobots they left with. No worries, there is already a team waiting for them. A team of...SEEKERS? Maybe SOME worries should be had as Thundercracker and Starscream inform you that Shockwave and the Quintessons are hatching some evil plans. Will the world shake apart as you team up with those who seek to destroy? Find out in SHOCK, SCREAM, THUNDER! 

*Date: April 1st~April 15th
*Bots of the Month: Wheeljack, Dinobot, Barricade

sections.heading: Twist of Fates
sections.text:
Quintessons betray Shockwave, nobody is surprised, except Shockwave. Starscream and Thundercracker now work with the freshly arrived Autobots to pick up the pieces. The Quintessons seem to have a frightening control over the time-stream and an army is growing. What can save the Bots? Where will they jump to next? Only TIME will tell with this TWIST OF FATES.

*Date: April 15th~April 29th
*Bots of the Month:

sections.heading: Might as Well Jump
sections.text:
This world needs Cliffjumper to disrupt the timeline! Can Wheeljack and Jetfire figure out the tangled web of time to jump their friend here? Or will they only make more knots in this already complex multiversal mayhem? There’s no time to spare and no other plan so we MIGHT AS WELL JUMP! 

* Date: April 29th~May 13th
* Bots of the Month: Kickback, Shockwave, Hound
*Notes: 4th Anniversary 20% Gold and XP Boost

sections.heading: Jump Around
sections.text:
Bringing over a new Autobot is no easy task, and headstrong Cliffjumper may have been living the tough life on his own for too long as he seems a bit TOO eager for a fight. This is only the start of the Autobots’ troubles. Will they manage to keep on track, or will they lose footing as they JUMP AROUND?

*Date: May 13th~May 27th
*Bots of the Month:

sections.heading: Animal Altercation
sections.text:
Rhinox’s space bridge was wrecked by Cliffjumper coming through, ruining their chances to go back. What’s worse it seems that Wheeljack missed a figure or two in his calculations and his meddling with time and space is having far-reaching consequences across New Quintessa! Will the Maximals be able to rally, or will they fall victim to this ANIMAL ALTERCATION!? 

*Date: May 27th~June 10th
*Bots of the Month: Optimus Prime G1, Mixmaster, Drift, Tantrum

sections.heading: Purple Reign
sections.text:
Scorponok and Waspinator are a great pair, but they know they need a leader. With the timelines and reality of New Quintessa shifting this may be their chance to do something no one ever thought was possible… To give up on getting their REAL Megatron here and paint Dinobot purple!

*Date: June 10th~June 24th
*Bots of the Month:

sections.heading: Fog of War: Gorilla in the Mist
sections.text:
The multiverses are still open and Beast Bots are spilling in from all over. There are reports that a leader of these dangerous animals is deep within the latest Fog Of War and it's up to the Commander to see if they can capture the GORILLA IN THE MIST!
*Date: June 24th~July 1st
*Notes: Crystal Open Alliance Event for the same above mentioned period.

sections.heading: Cliffjump the Shark
sections.text:
Cliffjumper is feeling understandably disconnected in this timeline. His reality has only been fighting and taking care of himself, luckily (or unluckily) it seems some other lost Bots are looking for fresh leadership. The SHARKTICONS look to put Cliffjumper through his paces and see if he's worthy of joining (or maybe even leading) their ranks! Will he take a bite out of the competition, or will he fall short as we CLIFFJUMP THE SHARK.

*Date: July 1st~July 15th
*Bots of the Month: Waspinator, Megatron Gen, Prowl

sections.heading: Free Sharky
sections.text:
Cliffjumper gives the Sharkticon’s and S-1000 freedom from leaders forever, through defeating all their prior leaders. However this new and complicated timeline may not be Cliffjumper’s cup of Energon. Will he want to lead? Will he want to stay? All we know is that he’s going to be in for the fight of his life if he has any hope to FREE SHARKY! 

Date: 10AM EDT July 15th~July 29th

sections.heading: Patch Atoms
sections.text:
Ratchet helps out bots that have been affected by the recent space bridge shattering and other time anomalies. Who will be willing to accept the help of an Autobot? What kind of procedures will need to be done mid-battle? Will Ratchet have the patience for his patients? You'll have to find out as he tries to PATCH ATOMS 

*Date: July 29th~August 12th
*Bots of the Month: Grimlock, Cheetor, Mirage

sections.heading: The Only Sound
sections.text:
Nemesis Prime thought that his task was to align the tangle of time-lines on New Quintessa into one glorious thread. However it seems that the knot has gotten out of hand and he’s starting to lash out at the biggest Bots he can find. Will Nemesis find unity or destruction as he sees if he can hear THE ONLY SOUND. 

*Date: August 12th~August 26th
*Notes: 8.7 update and 8.7.1 patch

sections.heading: Golden Gears
sections.text:
Marissa is tasked with a troubling assignment. With Nemesis Prime no longer monitoring timeline twisting events, some MASSIVE tasks fall upon her shoulders. She recruits the Commander to help with the first of these missions, ensuring that Galvatron sends back a Golden Disc of vital information to his past self. Will the Commander be up for the mission? Will it stumble before it even takes off? We’ll see what winds up in the GOLDEN GEARS!

*Date: August 26th~September 9th
* Bots of the Month: Sideswipe, Arcee, Jetfire, Cyclonus

sections.heading: Double Back Again
sections.text:
Marissa is still convinced that to begin repairing the timeline certain events must occur as originally written in Teletraan’s databanks. Starting with the unpleasant plans to get them out of the way she looks to assist the Decepticons in sending back a Golden Disc to Megatron that is fabled to give him information on future events. However, if she thought the Autobots were unwilling to assist with this goal, just wait until she sees how stubborn a Decepticon can be when offered help! Will she make the past happen on time, or will she need to DOUBLE BACK AGAIN? 

*Date: SEPTEMBER 9th~September 30th
* Notes: Arcee and Barricade Fixes and Updates

sections.heading: Bump in the Night
sections.text:
Something has ripped open a door to the Dead Universe and ghosts from a dark and troubling timeline have begun leaking into New Quintessa. Since this is some new paranormal science, and everyone else is busy, Marissa turns to Wheeljack to go out there and smash some spectres. Will Wheeljack be able to fight back his fears and discover what’s going BUMP IN THE NIGHT?

*Date: September 30th~October 14th
* Bots of the Month: Bonecrusher, Optimus Primal, Ultra Magnus

sections.heading: In the Afterlife
sections.text:
A rip to the Dead Dimension has been spotted and it’s up to Wheeljack and Jetfire to take a walk through the abyss to try and sort things out. What terrors will be revealed? Where will the journey take them? How will they stop bickering for long enough to answer the last two questions? Only way to find out is to find the team IN THE AFTERLIFE! 

*Dates: October 14th~October 28th

sections.heading: Tale as Old as Time
sections.text:
Jetfire and Wheeljack unexpectedly land out of the dead universe in the distance future after the end of the Autobot and Decepticon war and meet the Maximals who are battling over the Golden Disc. Unfortunately the arrival of the Autobots have some very unexpected results on the future forms of their Maximal descendants. 

*Date: 10AM EDT October 28th ~ November 11th
*Bots of the Month: Hot Rod, Galvatron, Cinematic Optimus Prime
* Notes: 8.8 update

sections.heading: A Lesson Learned in Time
sections.text:
All this time-travel, world hopping, and reality bending seems to be getting to the heroic Autobots Wheeljack and Jetfire. As they continue searching for a Golden Disk lost in time, they run into a familiar face from the past also seeking some control. Perhaps there is more to discover than it seems at first, as these Bots find themselves with A LESSON LEARNED IN TIME. 

*Dates: 9AM EST November 11th ~ November 25th

sections.heading: Sound and Fury
sections.text:
MEANWHILE BACK ON NEW QUINTESSA. Things are getting loud and strange as an experiment seems to have gone haywire and Autobots are reporting back blocked broadcasts and terrible tunes! Who could be behind this menacing musical madness? Hopefully Jazz, Bumblebee, and the Commander can find the source of this SOUND AND FURY!

*Date: November 25th ~ December 9th.
*Bots of the Month: Rhinox, Scorponok, Grindor, Megatron (ROTF)

sections.heading: Grimlock Saves Ember Festival
sections.text:
EMBER LIGHT FESTIVAL: It is a time of year where the world is the darkest, but noble Bots still warm themselves with the company of each other’s Sparks and the spirit of giving. There’s no bigger fan of this tradition than GRIMLOCK but he MAY have more SPIRIT than SENSE when it comes to celebration. Will things get scrapped or will we find that GRIMLOCK SAVES EMBER FESTIVAL!? 

*Date: December 9th ~ December 23rd
* Notes: Fixed an issue where sometimes Projectiles are slower when fighting Nemesis Prime, Adjusted the timing on Cliffjumper's SP3 so Glass Gas Debuffs don't run out during the special animation

sections.heading: Fog of War: Spirit of Ember Future
sections.text:
A new seeker has been spotted in the skies. As the Commander approaches the edge of the Fog of War this mysterious and dark specter of a Seeker steps out to warn them of a foreboding future. Who is this Seeker? What waits ahead? And what will light the way in with the SPIRIT OF EMBER FUTURE?

* Date: December 23rd ~ December 30th
The Spotlight Missions with the return of new bots are now sub-titled Bot Incursions.

sections.heading: Gatekeepers
sections.text:
There’s a blank spot on the map and it’s causing distress back in Autobot HQ. A brand new anomaly is making itself known, guarded by Decepticons, and rumored to be cursed. Can Wheeljack and the Commander break through enemy lines to learn more? Or will they find themselves stopped by some sinister GATEKEEPERS? 

*Date: December 30th ~ January 13th.
*Bots of the Month: Ratchet, Jazz, Starscream
*Notes:

sections.heading: Fight or Flight
sections.text:
There seems to be something new and scary happening on New Quintessa. While Wheeljack is off researching it, another Bot is looking for more immediate actions. SHOCKWAVE is taking the Commander for a trip deeper into the anomaly to retrieve some Decepticon Seekers! Will this mission spell doom and gloom? We’ll have to see as we take FIGHT OR FLIGHT!

* Date: January 13th ~ January 27th.
* Bots of the Month:
*Notes:

sections.heading: Fear.exe
sections.text:
Wheeljack is joined by some back-up Bots to see if they can reach the space bridge. Wheeljack thinks he may have found a way to turn down the code of fear that Dirge has put out, but as with many of Wheeljack’s experiments things don’t go as planned. Will the Autobots be able to fight on to find more Bots? Or will their final program be run as they face FEAR.EXE.

*Date: January 27th ~ February 10th
*Bots of the Month: Soundwave, Bludgeon, Ramjet
*Notes:

sections.heading: No Way Back
sections.text:
Having moved past the fear Dirge placed on the natural spacebridge, Optimus and Bumblebee head out to investigate the source of the new Deceptions. What use can this bridge have? What horrors does it hold? There is much debate, even amongst the Autobots, about what to do with this dangerous gate. Will the Autobots find a way home? Or will they discover there is NO WAY BACK?

*Date: February 10th ~ February 24th.
*Notes: 9.0 update and 5th anniversary calendar and boosts

sections.heading: Mean Gears
sections.text:
Space Bridges, Wormholes, and other Time-Space Anomalies have been thrown open all across New Quintessa. Some Bots have been finding their way here who may not have even noticed they crossed over. Such is the case with SKYWARP who finds himself once again on the Seeker Squad as they reintroduce themselves and begin their plots to take control of their destiny. Who will fall to these severe Seekers, and will they be ground up by their MEAN GEARS? 

*Date: February 24th ~ March 10th
*Bots of the Month: Skywarp, Sideswipe, Prowl, Scorponok, Galvatron
* Notes:

sections.heading: Losing Ground
sections.text:
The Seekers have gained a new member in Skywarp, but have they lost touch with the rest of New Quintessa? It may turn out that three seekers isn’t just a crowd, it’s a COUP! Will Starscream and Thundercracker keep control of Skywarp or will they be LOSING GROUND?

*Date: March 10th~March 31st
*Bots of the Month:
*Notes:

sections.heading: Branding Iron
sections.text:
Natural Space Bridges continue to provide new Bots a path to New Quintessa. Autobot backup should be a cause for celebration, but it seems like some big egos (and bigger blasters) are clashing as IRONHIDE joins his compatriots. Will the Commander be able to turn down the heat on this feud or will they find themselves marked by a BRANDING IRON?

*Date: March 31st~April 14th
*Bots of the Month: Ironhide, Blaster, Grindor, Cyclonus, Dinobot
*Notes:

sections.heading: Turned to Steel
sections.text:
The Decepticons are in disarray, disagreement, and on a disastrous path. The Autobots look to use this to their advantage but is their team truly together? New arrivals add fire-power but their lack of preparation may be their downfall! Will Ironhide and Bumblebee have each other’s backs, or will their Sparks be TURNED TO STEEL?

*Date: April 14th~May 5th.
*Bots of the Month:
*Notes: Extended anniversary boost.

sections.heading: Screen Time
sections.text:
Autobots from an alternative universe feel that the Commander has been playing favorites and abandoning them in battle. Will the Commander be able to convince the Autobots that they have their backs no matter the challenge? Or will they become distracted by Decepticon dangers? You’ll need your whole focus as you manage your SCREEN TIME.

*Date: May 5th~May 19th
*Bots of the Month:
*Notes:

sections.heading: A Bad Name
sections.text:
A new Decepticon has entered the fight in New Quintessa! Slipstream has arrived and it looks like Megatron has decided to utilize her particular set of skills. It’s time to clean house in the Decepticon camp and the first on the list are those who dared not to fall in line with Megatron’s rule. Will Slipstream change the course of battle? Or will they just prove they are living up to A BAD NAME? 

*Date: May 19th~June 2nd
*Bots of the Month: Slipstream, Optimus Primal, Cheetor, Kickback, Tantrum
*Notes:

sections.heading: Who Run the World
sections.text:
Seeing the possibilities of a new arrival, Arcee and Windblade seek to see if Slipstream can be reasoned with, and possibly even recruited. However the Bots don’t exactly see optic to optic and Slipstream seems more interested in leading a new team rather than joining any of the old ones. Will Arcee and Windblade convince this Decepticon to fight for the greater good? Or will we really figure out which are the Bots WHO RUN THE WORLD? 

*Date: June 2nd~June 22nd
*Bots of the Month:
*Notes: 9.1.1 patch

sections.heading: Nothing and Everything
sections.text:
After defeating the newly arrived dimension-hopping SLIPSTREAM, the Commander and Autobots gain some valuable intel. A Bot, thought to be lost to the multiverses, has been here on New Quintessa! RODIMUS PRIME has been spotted in a dangerous place between dimensions. Will Arcee, Bumblebee, and Wheeljack be able to find their lost friend? Or will they find NOTHING AND EVERYTHING?

*Date: June 23rd~July 7th
* Bots of the Month: Rodimus Prime, Dirge, Arcee, Wheeljack, Shockwave
* Notes:

sections.heading: Dare to Believe
sections.text:
Rodimus Prime is back amongst the Autobots on New Quintessa, but it’s not a happy reunion. Seeing Optimus only brings back bitter memories for Rodimus, of how he may have failed in the past, and the uncertainty of his future. Will Rodimus Prime arise as a new force amongst the Autobots? Do we DARE TO BELIEVE?

*Date: July 7th~July 28th
* Bots of the Month:
*Notes:

sections.heading: Training Montage
sections.text:
Mirage has made some interesting improvements on his invisibility tech, now he can project perfect copies of his Autobot friends! The tech is still in the testing phase but he wants the Commander to train alongside some Autobot pals as he figures it out. To keep spirits up, Blaster is also on site to ensure that there’s some terrific tunes for this TRAINING MONTAGE.

*Date: July 28th~August 11th
*Showcase Bots: Jetfire, Hound
*Notes:

sections.heading: Shining Star
sections.text:
Sunstreaker has arrived on New Quintessa, much to the delight of his twin brother Sideswipe. But not all is well within the Autobot family reunion as Sunstreaker seems to have it out for the Commander. Will Sideswipe be able to sway his brother into falling in line with their new human friend, or will we be blinded by the rage of this SHINING STAR?

*Date: August 11th~August 25th
*Bots of the Month: Sunstreaker, Mixmaster, Optimus Prime (MV1), Grimlock, Drift
*Notes:

sections.heading: Those Fortunate Ones
sections.text:
Sunstreaker isn’t keen on joining any team the Commander is a part of, so they look to get the party started on their own terms. Can Sunstreaker and his brother Sideswipe find some Bots to join the cause? If they do, who will be THOSE FORTUNATE ONES? 

*Date: August 25th~September 15th
*Bots of the Month:
*Notes:

sections.heading: Play the Hits
sections.text:
A new Bot has appeared on New Quintessa, or have they been here all along? A miscommunication leads the Commander to the secret lair of Soundblaster who is claiming to have some big plans for this little world. Will this new tune sync up with the Autobot and Decepticon playlists? We’ll have to find out as we drop the needle on this track to PLAY THE HITS!

*Date: September 15th~September 29th
*Bots of the Month: Soundblaster, Rhinox, Mirage, Megatron (ROTF), Optimus Prime (Gen)
*Notes:

sections.heading: Make Some Noise
sections.text:
The Commander has managed to join Soundblaster’s team of do-badders as a double-agent as they report back to Autobot HQ. It seems like Soundblaster has some dark plans for New Quintessa, as they are gathering forces and looking to cause trouble. Will the Commander be able to sneak along with them and figure things out? Or after this adventure will they even be able to MAKE SOME NOISE?

*Date: September 29th~October 20th

sections.heading: Release the Beast
sections.text:
Strange times make for strange team-ups. With the shakeup of New Quintessa teams, the Maximals have decided to expand their ranks WITH SHARKTICONS! Will these finned foes become fantastic friends? Hopefully their training will be enough to RELEASE THE BEAST!

* Date: October 20th ~ November 3rd
*Notes: Gorilla in the Mist Fog of War re-launched on 2nd week for the rest of the game.

sections.heading: A Glass Darkly
sections.text:
New Quintessa is ripping apart, universes are collapsing, evil seems to be around every corner, it's time for old friends to come and help! Luckily, Shattered Glass Megatron and Starscream, the delightful Decepticon Duo, are here to lend some firepower to the fight! Will these reflected doubles be enough to buy our heroes some time, or will they only be reflected in A GLASS DARKLY?

* Date: November 3rd ~ November 17th
* Bots of the Month: Motormaster, Windblade, Ultra Magnus, Barricade

sections.heading: Sky's the Limit
sections.text:
More information is being learned about the terrible fate awaiting New Quintessa. Optimus has hope that he can perhaps buy some time to escape, but the skys are darkened by one last attack from the SEEKERS! Will the Commander be able to free their friends and escape, or will they find that the SKY’S THE LIMIT?!

* Date: November 17th ~ December 1st

sections.heading: Exodus Protocol
sections.text:
The time has come to leave this world, its many realities, its countless timelines, and seek adventure in the infinite multiverse. However, dark forces still look to claim what power remains and perhaps corrupt all worlds beyond. One final mission remains, as Optimus and the Commander initiate the EXODUS PROTOCOL.

* Date: December 1st ~ January 13th, 2023

Going into 2023, the Exodus Protocol mission was the only one running until lights out.

The game's second wind found no new Special Missions being run, the only thing in play being a continuous Fog of War cycle.

But it happens that a new movie featuring the Beast Bots is coming out, so pleasantries have been made with a second helping of...

sections.heading: Proving Grounds
sections.text:
...Giving Commanders another go with the Beasties.
* Date: June 9-?
* Notes: Also, the Mirage Gauntlet.

sections.heading: Legends of Cybertron
sections.text:
{{main|Legends of Cybertron}}
Unlocked at level 25, these permanent Special Missions are the uttermost difficult missions in the game.

sections.heading: Rulers of Kaon
sections.text:
Optimus, inspired by his Megatron's arena-fighting past, invites ROTF Megatron to spar with many Bots powered by a special Module made by Mixmaster.
*Completion Rewards: 4-Star Harm Accelerator, Fallen Titan Hand, 3 T3 Basic Spark, 2 T2 Alpha Spark, T3 Class Spark Crystal

sections.heading: Revenge of the King
sections.text:
Grimlock arrives to take his place as King, but the Commander challenges him to it; in response, the King welcomes you to Jurassic Spark! Do you choose to endorse the park, or not?
*Completion Rewards: 10,000 5-Star Bot Crystal Shards, 1 Tier 4 Basic Spark, 1 of each Tier 3 Class Spark, 10 5-Star Signature Upgrades, Stable Nucleon Core Relic

sections.heading: Rise of Kolkular
sections.text:
Thundercracker attempts to bring the Decepticon base to New Quintessa. If you are to stop him, he has imposed a two-bot limit and six Class Gates potentially blocking your path. At least he has a heart spark light enough to node his challenges with potentially very overpowered modules. If you are able to strike him down, you will get a handsome reward...

Also, Titan Fragments! 
*Completion Rewards: 100,000 Titan Fragments, 10,000 5-Star Bot Crystal Shards, 3 Tier 4 Basic Sparks, 2 Tier 4 Class Spark Crystals, 1 Generic 5-Star Signature Awakening Program, 1,000,000 Gold
* Exploration Rewards: 200,000 Titan Fragments, 20,000 5-Star Bot Crystal Shards, 6 Tier 4 Basic Sparks, 2 Tier 4 Class Spark Crystals, 4 Tier 3 Alpha Sparks, 1 Generic 5-Star Signature Awakening Program, 2,000,000 Gold

sections.heading: 1) Once A Decepticon
sections.text:
Part 1: 

Optimus Prime: Commander, I bring disturbing news. There are reports that our Autobot comrade Drift has...gone rogue.

Optimus Prime (MV1): Rogue?! How so? He is an Autobot of unquestionable valour.

Optimus Prime: He was seen leaving our base uttering threats against an Autobot.

Optimus Prime (MV1): I find that difficult to believe. Which Autobot?

Optimus Prime: Hot Rod.

Optimus Prime (MV1): How can that be? Teletraan hasn't tracked Hot Rod's presence on this accursed planet.

Optimus Prime: Therein lies the intrigue. Perhaps if we find Drift, Hot Rod's presence will be confirmed... and allegiances can be certified.

Part 2:

Optimus Prime: Readings indicate the target is up ahead.

Optimus Prime(MV1): By target you mean Drift? He is an Autobot. He is my friend.

Optimus Prime: If he has gone rouge, he is a target that may lead us to Hot Rod.

Part 3: 

Optimus Prime(MV1): Argh, Ratchet just sent word that I need to return to base.

Optimus Prime: For what reason?

Optimus Prime(MV1): He's been monitoring my bio-cyber readouts and is concerned I may have developed a Cybertonium leak.

Optimus Prime: If true, that could lead to serious malfunctions. Malfunctions that could jeopardize both you and the mission. I suggest you heed Ratchet's warning and head back to base.

Optimus Prime(MV1): I've never known Ratchet to be wrong. I shall head back. But on one condition... when you find Drift, know that he is an Autobot. Treat him accordingly.

Optimus Prime: I will treat him according to his actions, I can promise nothing more.

Part 4:

Barricade: Ah, the mighty purveyor of sentient freedom approaches.

Drift: He travels with the Commander... looks like someone is interested in a fight.

Optimus Prime: Drift! You keep dubious company... to say the least. I request that you return to the base. We have matters to discuss.

Drift: Matters can wait. I have business to attend to.

Optimus Prime: Decepticon business?

Drift: MY business. It does not concern one from your reality.

Optimus Prime: Am I to conclude your allegiances lie with the Decepticons?

Drift: If you want to discuss allegiances, talk to Barricade. I have only one allegiance now... vengeance!

sections.heading: 2) AWOL
sections.text:
Part 1:

Prowl: Commander, that punk Drift has gone AWOL and Decepticon. A bad combo if there ever was one.

Optimus Prime: Pump the brakes on accusations, Prowl.

Prowl: Why? By your own account he's been consorting if not conspiring with Decepticons. And, what about the vengeance nonsense?

Optimus Prime: It is true things seem awry. But I believe there is more to this than meets the optical receptors. I promised my alter-reality brethren that I would afford his Drift the benefit of the doubt. I intend to do so.

Part 2:

Optimus Prime: Drift's exhaust readings are growing weaker. We need to hurry.

Prowl: Why the urgency, Optimus? If Drift has returned to his Decepticon roots, let him go. We have enough headaches with the Quintessons and Megatron running amok.

Optimus Prime: I understand your concern, friend. But, I made a promise to bring him back. Besides, Drift was heard to have mentioned the arrival of Hot Rod. If that is true, Drift is our best lead to find him.

Part 3: 

Prowl: Hey, dumptruck...

Mixmaster: It's Mixmaster, Automoron.

Prowl: Whatever. Have you seen any suspicious looking samurai wannabes in these parts?

Mixmaster: Yeah, I saw him... was heading up the way. Rambling on about serving justice to a traitor. Little good that will do you, though. 

Prowl: Oh, why's that?

Mixmaster: You've reached your final destination. Me!

sections.heading: 3) Autobot Traitors
sections.text:
Part 1: 

Marissa Faireborn: Optimus, we're getting strange readings from your forward position.

Optimus Prime: I can confirm things are indeed strange here. Drift's trail has lead us to a new region.

Marissa: Be careful. Teletraan is registering temporal anomalies in the area that are off the charts.

Optimus Prime: Thanks for the update, we will proceed with due caution, but Drift must be found.

Part 2: 

Mirage: You summoned me, Optimus?

Optimus Prime: Yes, the Commander and I need your unique scouting skills.

Mirage: I can guess why. Everyone back at HQ is talking about Drift going rogue. They say he's turned.

Optimus Prime: That has yet to be proven, but initial signs aren't reassuring.

Mirage: I know what it's like to be wrongfully accused of disloyalty. It is rather distressing. You want me to scout the path ahead for Drift, correct?

Optimus Prime: That is the plan. But be warned, this new terrain is fraught with peculiarities we haven't fully identified yet.

Part 3:

Mirage: Commander, Optimus... Drift awaits just ahead. And from what I can tell, he's definitely out of sorts.

Optimus Prime: By the horns of Unicron! Drift, what has become of you?!

Drift: Stay out of this, Prime. I bear you no ill will... just the Autobot traitor that forsook his own in our time of need!

Optimus Prime: Autobot traitor?

Drift: Yes, they called him Hot Rod. I call him dead.

Optimus Prime: I don't know what you speak of, but you must be mistaken. Return to base with me and we can sort this out. That's an order.

Drift: I don't take orders from you... fake Optimus. You want me to return? Then make me!

sections.heading: 1) Uncharted Territory
sections.text:
Part 1:

Marissa: This new territory requires a new approach to scouting. I'm sending the aerial and stealth talents of Waspinator with you.

Rhinox: And, I'm tagging along to make sure we don't have anymore "defections." The bug was once a Decepticon aligned Predacon.

Waspinator: Bah... ancient history. Wazzzzpinator turned over a new wing.

Marissa: This is uncharted territory.

Waspinator: Who needs charts? All you need is Wazzzzpinator!

Rhinox: ... and my Chainguns of Doom!

Part 2: 

Waspinator: Uh-oh, trouble ahead.

Rhinox: Commander, I believe we found what we're looking for.

Drift: That's right, it doesn't matter how many times you lecture me... I will find the one I seek.

Rhinox: The one they call Hot Rod.

Drift: Yes, and he lies in wait just ahead.

Rhinox: Commander, we should accompany Drift. This Hot Rod is the key. We must learn more.

Drift: Come if you like. You'll learn how he dies!

Part 3:

Drift: There he is, the traitor. The Autobot that would not heed Optimus's call in a time of ultimate crisis.

Hot Rod: Drift, I get Spacebridged here to this Primus-forsaken land and you greet me like that.

Drift: I greet you like one who would cower while others perish.

Hot Rod: You know we all had our orders when we were on Earth.

Drift: Orders to hide while the rest of us risked our lives?

Hot Rod: Surely Optimus told you of my mission. I was playing the long game. The asset I was assigned to protect was too valuable to blow my cover.

Drift: All I know is good bots paid the most serious price for your cowardice. For that you will pay.

Ironhide: Yeah well. I was there when the Energon first hit the fan and I don't remember you being there. He had his orders. We all did. Hot Rod, take off, I'll handle this.

sections.heading: 2) Brothers At Arms
sections.text:
Part 1:

Prowl: Again we get a lead on Hot Rod... and again Drift is in the middle of it.

Bumblebee (DOTM): Enough of the name calling and accusations.

Prowl: Easy for you to say, he's your Drift.

Bumblebee(DOTM): Mine? I don't "own" any sentient beings. It's kind of against Prime's directive.

Prowl: The Drift we're looking for is from your reality, so you're accountable for his actions... and loyalties.

Part 2: 

Prowl: Look at who we found. Deceptidrift!

Drift: Still the accusations when the true traitor, the true rouge lies ahead?

Bumblebee(DOTM): That's enough. There are no rogues... no traitors! only Autobots. One and all!

Drift: For a bot once of few words, you now say a lot.

Bumblebee(DOTM): I say what must be said. Now, let's go find our brother, Hot Rod.

Prowl: To Bring him in?

Bumblebee(DOTM): To hear him out...

Part 3:

Prowl: Target acquired. Commander, Drift, let's bring him back to HQ. Let the Primes sort this.

Drift: You heard him traitor, you're coming with us.

Hot Rod: I don't think so. From the short time I've been here on this bizzare planet. I'd say you're all mad. I'm not going anywhere.

Bumblebee(DOTM): Hot Rod, you need time. I've been there.

Drift: What are you saying?

Bumblebee(DOTM): I'm saying my friend needs time to adjust to his new surroundings. You are going to let him be...for now.

Hot Rod: Bee, you don't have to fight my fight.

Bumblebee(DOTM): After we went all through on Earth, it's the least I can do. Now go, clear your head... Optimus awaits.

sections.heading: 3) Bring Him Home
sections.text:
Part 1: 

Optimus Prime (MV1): Commander, Bumblee relayed the circumstances of your last encounter with Hot Rod. He, Drift and Bumblebee were under my lead. I have failed them.

I shall venture forth with you and try to restore order... and help our brother Hot Rod.

Bumbleebee(DOTM): What he said.

Part 2:

Optimus Prime(MV1):Hot Rod, my friend. It is good to see you. I wish it were under different circumstances.

Hot Rod: You mean circumstances that don't involve Autobots accusing me of being a traitor? How about Decepticons blowing up anyone they encouner? Maybe you're talking about weird looking bots that turn into beasts and insects?

Optimus Prime(MV1): I understand, this alternate reality is distressing. Let us help you.

Hot Rod: Thanks, but no thanks. I'm outta here until I am certain who I can trust. I don't know what you've got under the hood old bot, but I'm pretty sure you're not catching me!

Bumblebee(DOTM): Optimus, let's roll out!

Optimus Prime(MV1): Patience, Bee, patience. He'll tire and when he does, we'll get him the help he needs.

Part 3:

Optimus Prime(MV1): So, Hot Rod, are you ready?

Hot Rod: Ready for what?!

Optimus Prime(MV1): Ready for us to help you understand the gravity of our collective situation... and the perils we must overcome...together.

Hot Rod: Why should I trust you... or anything else? I spent years on my own, undercover on that crazed Earth. I can take care of myself.

Optimus Prime(MV1):It pains me to do this, but you leave me with no choice. Commander, you are authorized to use whatever means necessary to persuade Hot Rod to return to HQ with us. It is for his own good.

Hot Rod: That's what they all say. Let's do this!

Part 4: 

Optmus Prime(MV1): Good work, Commander. Hot Rod's extended exposure to the ill effects of the Dark Energon in the atmosphere has tampered with his circuitry. I'll get him back to HQ and see what Ratchet can do for him.Category: Special Missions

Part 2: 

Waspinator: Uh-oh, trouble ahead.

Rhinox: Commander, I believe we found what we're looking for.

Drift: That's right, it doesn't matter how many times you lecture me... I will find the one I seek.

Rhinox: The one they call Hot Rod.

Drift: Yes, and he lies in wait just ahead.

Rhinox: Commander, we should accompany Drift. This Hot Rod is the key. We must learn more.

Drift: Come if you like. You'll learn how he dies!

Part 3:

Drift: There he is, the traitor. The Autobot that would not heed Optimus's call in a time of ultimate crisis.

Hot Rod: Drift, I get Spacebridged here to this Primus-forsaken land and you greet me like that.

Drift: I greet you like one who would cower while others perish.

Hot Rod: You know we all had our orders when we were on Earth.

Drift: Orders to hide while the rest of us risked our lives?

Hot Rod: Surely Optimus told you of my mission. I was playing the long game. The asset I was assigned to protect was too valuable to blow my cover.

Drift: All I know is good bots paid the most serious price for your cowardice. For that you will pay.

Ironhide: Yeah well. I was there when the Energon first hit the fan and I don't remember you being there. He had his orders. We all did. Hot Rod, take off, I'll handle this.

sections.heading: 2) Brothers At Arms
sections.text:
Part 1:

Prowl: Again we get a lead on Hot Rod... and again Drift is in the middle of it.

Bumblebee (DOTM): Enough of the name calling and accusations.

Prowl: Easy for you to say, he's your Drift.

Bumblebee(DOTM): Mine? I don't "own" any sentient beings. It's kind of against Prime's directive.

Prowl: The Drift we're looking for is from your reality, so you're accountable for his actions... and loyalties.

Part 2: 

Prowl: Look at who we found. Deceptidrift!

Drift: Still the accusations when the true traitor, the true rouge lies ahead?

Bumblebee(DOTM): That's enough. There are no rogues... no traitors! only Autobots. One and all!

Drift: For a bot once of few words, you now say a lot.

Bumblebee(DOTM): I say what must be said. Now, let's go find our brother, Hot Rod.

Prowl: To Bring him in?

Bumblebee(DOTM): To hear him out...

Part 3:

Prowl: Target acquired. Commander, Drift, let's bring him back to HQ. Let the Primes sort this.

Drift: You heard him traitor, you're coming with us.

Hot Rod: I don't think so. From the short time I've been here on this bizzare planet. I'd say you're all mad. I'm not going anywhere.

Bumblebee(DOTM): Hot Rod, you need time. I've been there.

Drift: What are you saying?

Bumblebee(DOTM): I'm saying my friend needs time to adjust to his new surroundings. You are going to let him be...for now.

Hot Rod: Bee, you don't have to fight my fight.

Bumblebee(DOTM): After we went all through on Earth, it's the least I can do. Now go, clear your head... Optimus awaits.

sections.heading: 3) Bring Him Home
sections.text:
Part 1: 

Optimus Prime (MV1): Commander, Bumblee relayed the circumstances of your last encounter with Hot Rod. He, Drift and Bumblebee were under my lead. I have failed them.

I shall venture forth with you and try to restore order... and help our brother Hot Rod.

Bumbleebee(DOTM): What he said.

Part 2:

Optimus Prime(MV1):Hot Rod, my friend. It is good to see you. I wish it were under different circumstances.

Hot Rod: You mean circumstances that don't involve Autobots accusing me of being a traitor? How about Decepticons blowing up anyone they encouner? Maybe you're talking about weird looking bots that turn into beasts and insects?

Optimus Prime(MV1): I understand, this alternate reality is distressing. Let us help you.

Hot Rod: Thanks, but no thanks. I'm outta here until I am certain who I can trust. I don't know what you've got under the hood old bot, but I'm pretty sure you're not catching me!

Bumblebee(DOTM): Optimus, let's roll out!

Optimus Prime(MV1): Patience, Bee, patience. He'll tire and when he does, we'll get him the help he needs.

Part 3:

Optimus Prime(MV1): So, Hot Rod, are you ready?

Hot Rod: Ready for what?!

Optimus Prime(MV1): Ready for us to help you understand the gravity of our collective situation... and the perils we must overcome...together.

Hot Rod: Why should I trust you... or anything else? I spent years on my own, undercover on that crazed Earth. I can take care of myself.

Optimus Prime(MV1):It pains me to do this, but you leave me with no choice. Commander, you are authorized to use whatever means necessary to persuade Hot Rod to return to HQ with us. It is for his own good.

Hot Rod: That's what they all say. Let's do this!

Part 4: 

Optmus Prime(MV1): Good work, Commander. Hot Rod's extended exposure to the ill effects of the Dark Energon in the atmosphere has tampered with his circuitry. I'll get him back to HQ and see what Ratchet can do for him.Category: Special Missions

A Tale of Two Stingers is a Spotlight Mission featuring Scorponok and Waspinator that started on August 1.

sections.heading: = Part 1 =
= Part 2 =
Words, Words, Words
sections.text:
Part 1
* Scorponok: It feels like everyone is having big adventures without us.
* Waspinator: Wazzzpinator getzzz that feeling too. We are but playerzzz and all the world izzz a stage.
* Scorponok: Huh? Wait...does that sound like a sword fight?
* Waspinator: It soundzzz like metal hitting metal. ALL fighting soundzzz like that.
* Scorponok: Let's go check it out. Could be something to salvage after.
Part 2
* Cyclonus: Do you know how many have fallen to my blade? I have stood alongside Titans!
* Dinobot: Words, words, words. I only need one strike, and the rest is silence.
* Scorponok: DINOBOT! I THOUGHT I SMELLED A RAT!
* Waspinator: Other Maximal izzz a rat, Dinobot izzz a dino...bot!
* Cyclonus: Are they with you?
* Dinobot: They very much are not.
* Cyclonus: Then you shall not miss them when they are gone.
Part 3
* Dinobot: You are both honorless vermin.
* Scorponok: You talk a lot about honor for a double-dealing, two-faced, double-crosser!
* Waspinator: ALSO YOU CHANGED SIDEZZZ!
* Scorponok: Shut up! I got this!
* Waspinator: YEAH SHUT UP! HE HAZZZ IT!
* Dinobot: I did not think it possible to become as damaged as the pair of you.
* Scorponok: We are just FULL of surprises today!

sections.heading: At Terrible Odds
sections.text:
Part 1
* Scorponok: I'm absolutely certain we are now away from any danger.
* Hound: FIRE IN THE HOLE!
* Bludgeon: You call that pathetic puff of smoke "fire"? I'll show you fire-power!
* Scorponok: Get down! Get up! GET GONE!
* Waspinator: Wazzzpinator can't move! Too many explosionzzz!
* Hound: Clear out bug-brains! We're in the middle of a high-noon shoot-out here!
* Bludgeon: This is not a duel, it is an execution!
Part 2
* Hound: I value the target practice, but we were kinda' in a one-on-one thing.
* Bludgeon: By all means, add them to YOUR team. You could use the help.
* Waspinator: Predaconzz will not help car-bot!
* Hound: You heard fly-face! You take' em, they'll be buzzing around your body soon enough anyways!
* Bludgeon: I SAID YOU TAKE THEM!
* Hound: I SAID THE SAME TO YOU!
* Waspinator: Wazzzpinator is so popular!
Part 3
* Scorponok: There ya' go. One Autobot with this engine light flashing. You're welcome.
* Bludgeon: WELCOME? I am WELCOME? You have robbed me of a glorious battle!
* Waspinator: But... we helped. We saved you.
* Bludgeon: You worthless, meaningless, pathetic wastes of a spark think you SAVED ME?
* Scorponok: We phrased it a LOT nicer than you did but...yeah?
* Bludgeon: I WILL NOT BE DENIED A VICTORY THIS DAY!

sections.heading: Stark Raving Sane
sections.text:
Part 1
* Scorponok: We're in over our steps. Heading out of depth. Stepping out of our heads...It's all heading to a dead stop!
* Waspinator: Your wordzzz are all mixed up! Juzzzt like your head!
* Scorponok: We need some brain-power in here. Soundwave probably has some tech lying around.
* Waspinator: AGREED! All sortzzz of tech! Spy toolzzz and tapezzz that become birdzzz!
* Scorponok: Yeah maybe just the spy tools.
* Waspinator: ...Birdzzz...
Part 2
* Rhinox: Alright, it took some doing but the Molecular Transfer Device is offline!
* Soundwave: UNACCEPTABLE! Maximal interference has denied Decepticons Energon access!
* Waspinator: WE ARE HERE FOR YOUR TAPE BIRDZZZ!
* Soundwave: ...
* Commence termination of Predacon lifeforms.
Part 3
* Scorponok: You happy now? Help collect some of this before he gets back up.
* Rhinox: I don't know what your game is, but you're not getting the Molecular Transfer Device.
* Scorponok: The Monkey-Transit-what-now? Is that the stick-thing Primal used to fly on?
* Waspinator: WE'LL TAKE IT!
* Rhinox: You got some chrome bearings on you.
* Waspinator: Thank you! Device now?
* Rhinox: Over my slagged body.

sections.heading: Burning Bridges
sections.text:
Part 1
* Scorponok: All this stuff but no power source. Bet Prime power could get our plan going.
* Waspinator: Ape Prime not Truck Prime. Don't know how to deal with wheelzzz.
* Scorponok: Fine, we'll just sneak up on Primal and steal his Matrix. How hard could that be?
* Waspinator: Wazzzpinator trackzzz Primal over ridge! He izzz fighting Bully Bot!
* Scorponok: Tarantulas is here?!
* Waspinator: Different bully.
Part 2
* Optimus Primal: For the last time Tantrum, I'm not here for a fight.
* Tantrum: Any Bot without a Decepticon symbol is good as junk. Got a reputation to keep up.
* Waspinator: Friend Decepticon! Give Primal the hornzzz!
* Tantrum: All this headbuttin' has me in a haze. I'm seeing two bees.
* Waspinator: NOT TWO BEEZZZ! Wazzzpinaotr and Scorponok! Don't you know?
* Tantrum: Is that a question? I can't keep track of every bug wandering in and out of here.
* Scorponok: We ain't bugs...well half the time we are..but, we're Predacons the whole time!
* Tantrum: What you are, is in my way. Looks like I got to squash you before I go!
Part 3
* Optimus Primal: Faireborn, are you still reading?
* Marissa Faireborn: Right here Optimus. Situation report?
* Optimus Primal: The Commander has lead the pair right to me, But, I can not judge what they were trying to make.
* Scorponok: Same thing we were trying to make the other month, we need a Space Bridge!
* Optimus Primal: None of the materials you are carrying could possibly make a bridge, space or otherwise.
* Waspinator: Enough partzzz and we would have figured it out!
* Optimus Primal: This ends now. I suggest you focus on keeping this planet together, not rupturing it further.
* Waspinator: Wazzzpinator suggezzzt you get WRECKED!

sections.heading: Exits and Entrances
sections.text:
Part 1
* Scorponok: You know what I think?
* Waspinator: Wazzzpinator barely knowzzz what HE thinkzzz!
* Scorponok: I think know why we keep messing up!
* Waspinator: Good! What can we change to be the best botzzz here?
* Scorponok: This whole time, this whole mission, ever since I GOT HERE you know who we never tried to attack?
* Waspinator: WHO? TELL! TELL WAZZZPINATOR!
* Scorponok: THE COMMANDER!
Part 2
* Waspinator: Commander! Thatzzz who hazzz been following all along!
* Scorponok: I thought something was up, we barely fought the Bots we ran into. They were just sitting there behind their little gang.
* Waspinator: UNFAIR! THEY NEED TO FIGHT TOO!
* Scorponok: You're scrapping right they do! I say we make the Commander pay, make them suffer, make them know our WRATH!
* ...you go first.
* Waspinator: WITH PLEAZZZURE! WAZZZPINATOR! TERRORIZZZE!
Part 3
* Scorponok: Feeling big? Just you and me now! What do you have to say for yourself?
* Commnander: ...
* Scorponok: Yeah, I figured that's exactly how you'd respond to a REAL challenge.
* Marissa Faireborn: Commander! We have your location locked, do you need back-up?
* Scorponok: NO. This is going to get settled between me and you and your pathetic team.
* SCORPONOK! TERRORIZE!

sections.heading: Ruckus Identified
sections.text:
Part 1
*Ratchet: Optimus, we're getting readings of audio disturbances from the southern region with seismic ramifications.
*Optimus Prime: What could be causing such a ruckus?
*Ratchet: Not what, but who. Audio diagnostics I ran indicate a bot is responsible for this voluminous "disturbance.
*Optimus Prime: Soundwave?
*Ratchet: Uhh, no. The audio signature is Autobot in origin.
*Bumblebee: There is only one Autobot that could bring that ruckus... Blaster is in the house!
Part 2
*Ratchet: Commander, Optimus, the audio levels are getting worse... to the point of being destructive.
*Optimus Prime: Recommended course of action?
*Ultra Magnus: With all due respect, Optimus, the course of action is obvious. We have to find Blaster and unplug him.
*Optimus Prime: "Unplug" is an extreme measure.
*Ratchet: I'm sure he means that figuratively. But, we do need to "unplug" him until he realizes the damage his decibels can do in the unstable atmosphere of New Quintessa.
Part 3
*Blaster: Look who dropped in to get down! My main bot, Optimus!
*Optimus Prime: We did not come here to get down. We are here to turn down... the noise.
*Blaster: Aw c'mon. I know Primes don't party, but this place needs to get its groove on. The bots here are too uptight for their own good.
*Ratchet: I know you mean well...
*Ultra Magnus: But the party is over. Let's go, and hold it down.
*Blaster: No can do, Ultra Serious. The music is in me and there's no stopping it. Get beat or get beats... it's your choice.

sections.heading: Party Getting Started
sections.text:
Part 1
*Bumblebee (DOTM): Yo' Bee.
*Bumblebee: Yeah, Bee?
*Bumblebee (DOTM): Man, the whole alternate reality doppelganger thing is weird. Anyway, what do you know about this Blaster bot?
*Bumblebee: Aw, Blaster is a stand up, get down Autobot. He's loyal to both the Autobots and his love of getting the party started. Why do you ask?
*Bumblebee (DOTM): Well, there's been bit of a problem. The Commander and Ultra Magnus tried to bring him in to HQ and turn down the volume.
*Bumblebee: Oh-oh.
*Bumblebee (DOTM): Oh-oh is right. They had him under control when his cassettes ejected and sprung him loose.
*Bumblebee: That means the party is just getting started.
Part 2
*Optimus Prime: What are you doing here, soldier? You were assigned to recon patrol in the northern sector.
*Bumblebee (DOTM): Sorry, but I got sidetracked helping a friend help a friend.
*Optimus Prime: If this is about Blaster, the Commander and I will handle it. You have your orders. Carry them out.
*Bumblebee (DOTM): You're not the boss of me. Sure you're a Prime, but you're not my Prime.
*Optimus Prime: In times of duress we must endeavor to remain united. Return to the base, do your duty.
*Bumblebee (DOTM): Some other time... Prime.
Part 3
*Optimus Prime: Commander, the heavy reverb and pulsating bass suggest Blaster lies ahead.
*Bumblebee (DOTM): Lay off him. As someone that spent years with a broken vocal box cranking out random radio hits and movie quotes, I know what it's like to be misunderstood.
*Optimus Prime: That was not of my doing or my concern. My concern is our present safety.'
*Bumblebee (DOTM): C'mon Optimus Downer, sometimes you have to let a bot find himself. You've gotta let Blaster be Blaster.
*Optimus Prime: That is a terrible idea. Blaster's audio input endangers us all.
*Bumblebee (DOTM): Does it? Or, does it just annoy you that someone is enjoying the right of all sentient beings... to be free to be oneself?

sections.heading: Fight the Power
sections.text:
Part 1
*Optimus Prime: Optimus, if I may be so bold... what has possessed "your" Bee? His stubborn insubordination worries me.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): I fear stubbornness is a trait all Bees may possess.
*Optimus Prime: The Bee I know would never disobey me.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): I would not be so sure. My Bee said they are united in allowing this Blaster bot of yours to... I believe he said... "find his groove".
*Optimus Prime: If we are to restore a semblance of order and stability, Blaster and his "groove" must be found.
Part 2
*Bumblebee: Yo' Bee, what's the deal?
*Bumblebee (DOTM): I tried to hold them off, but that Commander has a stacked squad.
*Bumblebee: Thanks, bud, but it's my turn now. I'll slow them down and buy him some time.
*Bumblebee (DOTM): Time for what?
*Bumblebee: I talked with him and he says he's working on a new jam. He's claiming it's good enough to soothe a savage Dinobot.
*Bumblebee (DOTM): Wow, quite the claim.
*Bumblebee: Yeah, but I figure we oughta give him a shot at it. Grimlock's been acting rowdier than usual lately.
Part 3
*Optimus Prime: Say it is not so. You too?
*Bumblebee: Me too, what... Optimus?
*Optimus Prime: You too are in league with Blaster as he lays sonic waste to the land.
*Bumblebee: I'm not in league with anyone. I'm just trying to help a bro-bot find his groove.
*Optimus Prime: Translation?
*Bumblebee: I know you don't get it, but Blaster is an artist. It's in his park. He has to get it out, then he'll be fine.
*Optimus Prime: Get it out?! Bumblebee, get out of the way!
*Bumblebee: Not yet, sir. Blaster needs to kick out his jam. If that means I need to fight the power... so be it!

sections.heading: Primes Don't Party
sections.text:
Part 1
*Megatron: Are we not through with you yet?
*Starscream: Are you through with winning?
*Megatron: You are hardly one to speak of winning.
*Starscream: But, I have a plan. One that exploits the Primes' weakness.
*Megatron: And I have a brain and a giant gun. But, I suppose it would not hurt to discuss the Primes' weaknesses. What do you propose?
*Starscream: Recently, the Autobot Blaster has surfaced on new Quintessa. All reports are that he is driving the Primes mad with his incessant music playing.
*Megatron: Everyone knows Primes don't party. So what?
*Starscream: So we grab Blaster, trick him into playing his annoying ditty, and zap him with a T-Cog Disabler...
*Megatron: And use him to push the Primes over the edge. Create chaos of the sonic persuasion. Hmmm...
Part 2
*Blaster: Starscream? What are you doing here? Don't you have a back to stab somewhere?
*Starscream: Tsk-tsk, my fellow Cybertronian. I am a non-aligned bot of peace here on this deranged planet. You might say I follow the beat of own drummer.
*Blaster: I can get behind that, kinda going solo myself. But, what's that funky gadget?
*Starscream: A T-Cog Disabler.
*Blaster: What does it do?
*Starscream: You are as dumb as you are loud. I'll show you what it does if you show me that song everyone says you're working on.
*Blaster: I'm always down to get down, but I've got to transform first.
*Starscream: Sucker.
*Blaster:Argh!!!!
Part 3
*Sideswipe: Hey Optimus, looks like bringing me on the mission was a good call. Look who I found... Blaster!
*Optimus Prime: So I can hear. His choice in music is still as terrible as ever.
*Bumblebee: Yo, Blasty... it sounds like you've found your jam. Now, transform and let's roll out.
*Optimus Prime: You heard Bumblebee. Transform, it is time to go.
*Starscream: Why the rush? Maybe he just wants to bump his beats. Or maybe, he can't transform. Either way it sounds like we've got a party.
*Optimus Prime: What have you done to him?
*Starscream: Why, I've merely set him free to bring the noise.
*Bumblebee: Oh yeah, Decepticreep? You're going to see what it's like when a Killa Bee brings it!
Part 4
*Sideswipe: Jeez, what a piece of work. As soon as we save his beat blasting butt he lays down a circuit jamming track and takes off.
*Bumblebee: He's on a mission... a mission from Primus!
*Optimus Prime: That just means our mission continues. Roll Out!

sections.heading: Superior Beats
sections.text:
Part 1
*Megatron: Let me guess you sniveling sycophant, you have failed me again. And, as always, I'm sure it wasn't your fault.
*Starscream: But, it wasn't.
*Megatron: Of course.
*Starscream: The plan was sound, but I didn't account for Bumblebee's love of Blaster's wretched noise pollution.
*Megatron: Failure is failure.
*Starscream: A setback is not a failure. It is a learning opportunity. Blaster still has the potential to be a weapon of mass distortion. You'll see.
Part 2
*Soundwave: Lord Megatron, Shockwave has informed me that you collude with Starscream.
*Megatron: There is no collusion. I merely let the fool carry out an attempt to disrupt the Autobot forces using their own Blaster against them.
*Soundwave: Starscream and Blaster are both inferior bots. The potential for success was minimal. You only need to enlist the services of a superior bot... me.
*Megatron: If my datadrive serves me correctly, did Blaster not prove superior at your infamous Dancitron beat battle?
*Soundwave: That was an anomaly. My sub-woofer was malfunctioning.
*Megatron: Yet another excuse for another flunky that fails me.
*Soundwave: Your assessment is incorrect. I will prove my worth in the realm of audio warfare.
*Megatron: Actions speak louder than words. Prove it.
Part 3
*Soundwave: Cease your forward movement.
*Sideswipe: Huh?
*Bumblebee: I think he wants us to stop.
*Sideswipe: Why didn't he say so?
*Bumblebee: Whatever, we aren't stopping till we get our block rocking buddy Blaster back.
*Soundwave: That will not happen.
*Sideswipe: What's the deal, Soundwave... your cassettes need rewinding?
*Soundwave: Megatron needs verification.
*Bumblebee: Verification of what?

sections.heading: Time to Dance
sections.text:
Part 1
*Bumblebee: Things are popping out in the Wastelands, Optimus.
*Optimus Prime: I am sure they are, whatever that means. Do you have any word on Blaster?
*Bumblebee: Other than that he is a peacock and you've gotta let him fly?
*Optimus Prime: If my knowledge of Earth ornithology is correct, peacocks do not fly. But, that is beside the point. Clarify.
*Bumblebee: I'm just saying that he's an artist... he needs to express himself.
*Optimus Prime: He will be a dead artist if Soundwave and the Decepticons have their way.
*Sideswipe: Optimus is right, Bee. This has to end.
*Bumblebee: I suppose you're fight. But, I'm thinking Blaster has one more encore in him.
Part 2
*Blaster: What's cracking, Bee? I haven't seen you in a hot minute.
*Bumblebee: Ah, you know... just been doing the scouting, fighting, looking for you thing.
*Blaster: That's heavy, but I understand, bro-bot.
*Bumblebee: The thing is, Optimus has a point. It's time for you to come in and jam with us... your band, your alliance... The Autobots.
*Blaster: Yo' Bee, I'm not sure if I can give up the solo life just yet. Tell Optimus we need to get down one last time, a last chance to turn the funk out.
*Bumblebee: He wins... you come home?
*Blaster: Sounds like a deal for real, homebot.
Part 3
*Optimus Prime: Has Blaster come to his senses?
*Bumblebee: He's got one more track to lay down. Trust me, it's bad!
*Optimus Prime: I know, that's why this must end.
*Bumblebee: No, not bad meaning bad, but bad meaning good!
*Optimus Prime: Bumblebee, this nonsense is over. Point the way to Blaster.
*Bumblebee: Ok, Optimus. But, let him in on his own terms, to his own beat.
*Optimus Prime: I make no promises, but if he is ready to deal... we will deal.
Part 4
*Blaster: What's shaking, Optimus? Bee told me you'd be rolling through my hood.
*Optimus Prime: Yes, I tend to roll everywhere. For the last time, please return with us to HQ... in silence.
*Blaster: Before we do, it's time we dance... or we dance.
*Optimus Prime: You know Primes do not party... nor dance. Explain yourself.
*Blaster: I guess you're choosing to dance. Here's the deal. We get in on one last time while I play you my latest, greatest jam. You win... I leave with you. You lose, I get to keep kicking it solo.
*Optimus Prime: Let us dance.
